# Explicit String Vacua and the Geometric Selection Conjecture, release 3.1.0

The paper by Deep Bhattacharjee and Ushashi Bhattacharya in its amsart form (49 pages), with its LaTeX source, the arXiv tarball and the checking programs.

- New Section 16.3, "The extension branch". Lemma 16.6: the massless Abelian generators of an extension of the split bundle are the traceless kernel vectors of the charge matrix constant on the blocks. Lemma 16.7: a non-split extension of two line bundles of equal slope at a Kähler class J₀ is stable on the side of the wall through J₀ where the sub-line-bundle has the smaller slope. Proposition 16.8: a single rank-two extension never removes the forced Abelian factor, at any Kähler class. Theorem 16.10: two rank-two extensions remove it for six of the eleven three-family split data on the tetraquadric (the fixed datum and classes 2, 6, 7, 8, 10), each realised on one side of a stability wall through an explicit polystable class, with the extension groups computed exactly; for classes 4, 5 and 9 every such structure is excluded at every Kähler class, and for class 1 on the general tetraquadric (Lemma 16.9, a Koszul permutation certificate). Descent to the quotient, the spectrum and the Yukawa couplings of the extensions are not recomputed (Remark 16.11).
- Definition 9.1 fixes acceptance windows W for the three phenomenological conditions C7, C8, C9 (modulus masses at least 3 × 10⁴ GeV with no flat direction; GUT-scale Yukawa singular-value ratios within a factor 3 of the MSSM values and 0.15 ≤ |V_us| ≤ 0.30; a nonzero F-term with gravitino mass between 10³ and 10⁶ GeV), with the reason for each, and Conjecture 9.2 states the conjecture GSC(W) with those windows. Remark 9.3: every negative result of the paper holds for every choice of windows. The ledger (Table 7) records that the fixed datum fails C7_W, C8_W and C9_W for every window.
- `code/extension_branch.py` decides the extension branch in exact arithmetic (slope spaces, orientations, Koszul extension groups, polystable points and wall certificates; 61 checks, output `extension_branch_results.json`); `code/yukawa_charges.py` (45 checks) and `code/mirror_clause.py` (511 checks) are unchanged.
- The Geometric Selection Conjecture is not proved.

Assets: the PDF, the LaTeX source (tex.zip) and the arXiv tarball.
